EX PARTE NO. MC-37 (Sub-No. 26) 
\frac{1}{2} 
COMMERCIAL ZONES AND TERMINAL AREAS
Decided December 17, 1976
Upon investigation and consideration of views, arguments, and representations of the parties, conclusions reached as to motor carrier and freight forwarder terminal areas and as to commercial zones, and appropriate rules and regulations promulgated. Appropriate order entered.
